title: Compatible stalk algebra maps for a cartesian square
statement: For a cartesian square of schemes and a point z of the upper-left scheme, the stalk maps from the two factors to the upper-left stalk are algebra maps over the base stalk, agree with the displayed projection stalk maps, and have commuting images.

proof.text: Construct the two algebra homomorphisms from the scheme stalk maps. The equality of the two composites around the cartesian square, transported to stalks, proves the scalar compatibility; commutativity follows because the target stalk is commutative.

proof_origin.note: The compatibility argument is isolated as an intermediate theorem.

theorem exists_stalk_algebra_maps (z : X') :
    letI := leftAlgebra f g' z
    letI := rightAlgebra f f' g g' sq z
    letI := (f.stalkMap (g' z) ≫ g'.stalkMap z).hom.toAlgebra
    ∃ l : A g' z →ₐ[R f g' z] C z,
      ∃ r : B f' z →ₐ[R f g' z] C z,
        (∀ a, l a = (g'.stalkMap z).hom a) ∧
        (∀ b, r b = (f'.stalkMap z).hom b) ∧
        ∀ a b, Commute (l a) (r b)
